title: VBCDX agent-pack declaration (vbcdx-pack.json)
description: Shipped at the root of an agent pack: an npm package of agent roles and skills that `vbcdx install agent` and `vbcdx install skill` render. It is the agent-side twin of the tool declaration (vbcdx-tool.schema.json). It names the pack, where its roles and skills live, the role ids it ships in display order, and the tool contracts its roles can use. Each role is a directory <roles_dir>/<id>/ holding role.json (vbcdx-role.schema.json) and prompt.md. Every per-field rule is in this schema. The rules that span files are checked only by the reference loader (src/packs/load.js, readPack): roles_dir and skills_dir resolve inside the package, every listed role has its directory with both files, each role.json is valid and its id is the directory name, and every contract a role's dependencies name is listed in contracts. Validate with readPack, not with this schema alone.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editors: a relative path ending in vbcdx-pack.schema.json. No URL.

name.description: The pack's short name, shown by `vbcdx packs`. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

description.description: Optional one line saying what the pack is for.

roles_dir.description: Directory, relative to the package root, that holds one directory per role. Forward slashes, no '.' or '..' segment.

roles.description: The role ids the pack ships, in the order they are listed and installed. Each id is also its directory name under roles_dir and must be unique across every pack loaded together.

skills_dir.description: Optional directory, relative to the package root, holding the pack's skills: <category>/<NAME>.MD for a skill and <document>.md for a top-level document.

contracts.description: The tool contracts the pack's roles can use, for example vbcdx.forgejo/1. Every contract a role names in its dependencies must be listed here.

vars.description: Optional. The variables the pack's prompts use, written {{vars.<name>}} in a prompt. Each has a neutral default; an overlay (vbcdx-overlay.json) may set its own value. A prompt naming a variable not declared here is an error.

default.description: The value used when no overlay sets one: one line of printable text.

description.description: One line saying what the variable is.

roleId.description: Lowercase letters and digits in hyphen-separated words, at most 64 characters.
